title: Novel Palladium(II) beta-Diketonate Complexes: Synthesis, Dual Antimicrobial/Anticancer Activity, and Molecular Insights into DNA/Protein Interactions.
authors: Trifunovic Stevanovic, Marija; Joksimovic, Nenad; Petronijevic, Jelena; Stojanovic, Snezana; Dordevic, Sladana; Stankovic, Jelena Antic; Bufan, Biljana; Bozic, Dragana D
one_liner_zh: 该文研究钯(II)配合物的合成及抗菌/抗癌活性，虽含DNA/蛋白互作分子对接，但对象为小分子-生物大分子，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且方法以实验为主、对接为辅，与本课题TF-DNA结合建模关联弱。
abstract: This study reports the synthesis and biological evaluation of four novel palladium(II) complexes (B1-B4) with O,O-bidentate beta-diketo ester ligands. Spectroscopic characterization confirmed their structures, while biological assays revealed substituent-dependent activity. Complexes B3 and B4 showed the most consistent antimicrobial activity, with minimum inhibitory concentrations (MICs) of 312-1200 muM across the tested microorganisms. B3 exhibited the highest antiproliferative potency, with IC(50) values of 2.3, 5.2, and 5.4 muM against K-562, HeLa, and HaCaT cells, respectively. However, its selectivity varied with the cell model, reaching a selectivity index (SI) of 5.17 against K-562 cells relative to MRC-5 fibroblasts and 2.35 relative to HaCaT cells. B2 showed a more moderate activity profile, with some selectivity towards K-562 cells. Flow-cytometric analysis revealed increased sub-G0/G1 populations following treatment, consistent with the induction of apoptosis. Biophysical assays and molecular docking indicated structure-dependent interactions with DNA, while fluorescence studies revealed differences in the apparent binding affinities of the complexes toward human serum albumin (HSA). These findings highlight the influence of ligand structure on the biological activity and biomolecular interactions of palladium(II) complexes, identifying B3 as the most promising candidate for further investigation based on its antiproliferative potency and selectivity.
abstract_zh: 本研究报道了四种新型钯(II)配合物（B1-B4）的合成及其生物学评价，这些配合物含有O,O-双齿β-二酮酯配体。光谱表征确认了其结构，而生物学测定揭示了取代基依赖性活性。配合物B3和B4表现出最一致的抗菌活性，对测试微生物的最低抑菌浓度（MICs）为312-1200 μM。B3显示出最高的抗增殖效力，对K-562、HeLa和HaCaT细胞的IC(50)值分别为2.3、5.2和5.4 μM。然而，其选择性随细胞模型而变化，相对于MRC-5成纤维细胞，对K-562细胞的选择性指数（SI）达到5.17，相对于HaCaT细胞则为2.35。B2表现出较为温和的活性谱，对K-562细胞具有一定选择性。流式细胞术分析显示，处理后亚G0/G1期细胞群增加，与凋亡诱导一致。生物物理测定和分子对接表明，配合物与DNA之间存在结构依赖性相互作用，而荧光研究揭示了配合物对人血清白蛋白（HSA）表观结合亲和力的差异。这些发现强调了配体结构对钯(II)配合物生物活性和生物分子相互作用的影响，并基于抗增殖效力和选择性，确定B3为最值得进一步研究的候选化合物。
